research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Secureframe is researching systems and methods implementing a parallel search architecture for machine learning-informed response and augmentation of incomplete queries and query artifacts. These efforts focus on executing parallel search engines in a machine learning pipeline to retrieve candidate digital artifacts based on input queries, supporting the development of security and compliance software services. The research addresses efficient information retrieval and query processing within compliance contexts.

product.name: Secureframe Comply
product.description: A cloud-based security and compliance platform that automates evidence collection, control monitoring, risk management, policy administration, and compliance workflows across multiple frameworks.

product.name: Secureframe Defense
product.description: A cybersecurity and compliance platform for defense contractors that helps protect Controlled Unclassified Information and prepare for CMMC 2.0 requirements.

product.name: Secureframe Trust
product.description: A security information sharing solution that helps organizations present their security posture, compliance status, readiness reports, and responses to customer security inquiries.

product.name: Compliance and Security Advisory Services
product.description: Expert guidance that helps organizations prepare for, achieve, and maintain security and privacy compliance across applicable frameworks.
